question.text: Under the SEBI (Facilitation of Grievance Redressal Mechanism) (Amendment) Regulations, 2023, an AIF Manager must redress an investor grievance received through SCORES within:

answer.text: 7 calendar days from date of receipt
21 calendar days from date of receipt
15 calendar days from date of receipt
30 calendar days from date of receipt

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Ch 11.7.8 and the 2023 Amendment Regulations, AIF Managers shall redress investor grievances within 21 calendar days from the date of receipt. The Action Taken Report (ATR) is auto-routed to the investor via SCORES. **The Trap:** 7 and 15 days are faster benchmarks for other products (e.g., depository participants); 30 days was the older SCORES norm but now tightened to 21. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same 21-day window applies to several SEBI intermediaries; tested in III-A and XXI-A. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Set internal SLAs to resolve in 14 days, not 21 — the 7-day buffer handles escalation, management sign-off, and legal review without breaching the 21-day statutory deadline.
